dashboard.label: UniFi - Topology
dashboard.description: Live star topology: clients to APs/switches to the Dream Machine. Node color = errors in the last 5 minutes (green = none, red = errors). Click a node to open Device or Client Drilldown. Requires the "Network Diagram Viz" app.

search.query: ``` Node-style rows (devices + clients) set each node's icon (type) and error colour (= err+/meaningful events in the last 5 min). Edge rows (parent to child) carry the live uplink throughput as the link label. Client nodes use the MAC as the node id so drilldown can open Client Drilldown. ``` search `unifi_index` sourcetype=unifi:device:detail | stats latest(name) as name latest(model) as model latest(state) as state by id | eval type=case(match(model,"(?i)Dream Machine|UDM|UXG|gateway"),"globe", match(model,"(?i)USW|switch|PoE|US "),"sitemap", match(model,"(?i)U6|U7|AP|AC |Ultra|nanoHD|Lite|LR|Mesh"),"wifi", true(),"server") | join type=left name [ search `unifi_syslog` earliest=-5m latest=now (severity="err" OR severity="crit" OR severity="alert" OR severity="emerg" OR event_action="disconnect" OR event_action="kick" OR event_action="link_down" OR event_action="login_fail" OR match(_raw,"(?i)overheat")) | eval name=device_name | stats count as e by name ] | eval from=name, to="", nodetext=name, color=if(coalesce(e,0)>0,"red","green"), value="Device: ".name." Model: ".model." State: ".state." Errors(5m): ".coalesce(e,0) | table from to nodetext type color value | append [ inputlookup unifi_client_lookup | where isnotnull(uplink_device_name) AND uplink_device_name!="" AND ($show_clients$) | eval name=coalesce(client_name, client_mac) | join type=left name [ search `unifi_syslog` earliest=-5m latest=now (severity="err" OR event_action="disconnect" OR event_action="kick" OR event_action="login_fail") | eval name=coalesce(client_name, client_mac) | stats count as e by name ] | eval from=client_mac, to="", nodetext=name, type=if(client_type=="WIRELESS","laptop","desktop"), color=if(coalesce(e,0)>0,"red","green"), value="Client: ".name." IP: ".client_ip." MAC: ".client_mac | table from to nodetext type color value ] | append [ ``` device -> uplink edges (parent to child) with live throughput label ``` search `unifi_index` sourcetype=unifi:device:detail | stats latest(name) as name latest(uplink.deviceId) as up latest(unifi_device_mac) as mac by id | eval k=replace(lower(mac),":","") | lookup unifi_device_by_id device_id AS up OUTPUT device_name AS parent | join type=left k [ search `unifi_index` sourcetype=unifi:device:stats | eval k=replace(lower(unifi_device_mac),":","") | stats latest(uplink.rxRateBps) as rx latest(uplink.txRateBps) as tx by k ] | eval mbps=round((coalesce(rx,0)+coalesce(tx,0))*8/1e6,1) | where isnotnull(parent) AND parent!="" | eval from=parent, to=name, linktext=if(mbps>0, mbps." Mbps", "") | table from to linktext ] | append [ ``` client -> uplink device edges; 'to' is the client MAC (node id) ``` inputlookup unifi_client_lookup | where isnotnull(uplink_device_name) AND uplink_device_name!="" AND ($show_clients$) | eval from=uplink_device_name, to=client_mac, linktext=if(client_type=="WIRELESS","Wi-Fi","wired") | table from to linktext ]

panel.title: Star topology — globe = gateway, switch = switch, Wi-Fi = AP, laptop/desktop = wireless/wired client. Link label = live uplink throughput. Node colour = errors in the last 5 min. Click a node to open Device or Client Drilldown. Auto-refresh 5m.
